snippet.title: Lonely House | Release Date announce Trailer
snippet.description:
We’re excited to finally share a new trailer announcing the release date of our little game - Lonely House!

It's November 27, 2025!

It's a tiny game about home decorating with the goal to relax a player. We believe that there is beauty in the mundane, which is why in our game, a home can be decorated not only with beautiful decorative elements but also with various graffiti and other objects that aren't often considered beautiful.

If you enjoyed the trailer and you’re into cozy titles like Tiny Glade or Summerhouse, we’d be so happy to have your wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306140/Lonely_House/
